plain_policy: Picture this room as a true dining room: a table for four every day and six with guests, chairs that pull out, a sideboard, and the table under the light. The room is also the only way between the kitchen and the living room, so that walk must stay at least 24 inches with the chairs pushed in. Nothing may collide and every chair must be able to pull out. Everything else is a trade-off. Priorities in order: the kitchen-to-living walkway, room behind the chairs, seats, the table under the light, sideboard storage and serving room, rug fit, cost. The TV, sofa and lounge chairs that live here today move to the living room (see tv_room_function).
